title: UPSSSC UP Teacher Cadre Assistant J.T.C. Teacher Recruitment 2026 Mains Revised Answer Key
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC)
postName: Assistant Teacher Special Education / Teacher Cadre JTC / HTC – Advt. 03-Exam/2026
vacancyDetails: 58 posts of Assistant Teacher (JTC/HTC Grade including Music and special education related posts)
qualification: UPSSSC PET 2025 score card, 10+2 Intermediate, Diploma in Special Education in the relevant trade from RCI, and valid RCI registration as prescribed for the post.
ageLimit: 21 to 40 years as on 01 July 2026 (relaxations apply)
selectionProcess: PET eligibility shortlisting → Mains Written Examination → Answer Key / Revised Answer Key → Document Verification
documentsRequired: PET registration details, mains admit card, registration credentials, photo ID, 10+2 certificate, special-education diploma and RCI registration.
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open the Teacher Cadre JTC Advt. 03-Exam/2026 answer-key notice
3. Download the revised answer key PDF
4. Compare answers with the question paper and keep a copy
5. Follow the official instructions for any objection or next selection stage
shortDescription: UPSSSC Teacher Cadre JTC Mains Revised Answer Key 2026 released on 12 September for the 58-post Advt. 03-Exam/2026 recruitment.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the revised answer key for the Assistant Teacher Special Education / Teacher Cadre JTC Mains Examination 2026 under Advt. No. 03-Exam/2026.

The mains examination was held on 12 July 2026, and the revised answer key is available from 12 September 2026. This recruitment covers 58 posts across JTC and HTC grade teacher categories.

Important dates

  • Application: 06/04/2026 to 27/04/2026
  • Correction last date: 04/05/2026
  • Eligibility result: 16/06/2026
  • Exam city: 02/07/2026
  • Admit card: 08/07/2026
  • Mains exam: 12/07/2026
  • Answer key: 13/07/2026
  • Revised answer key: 12/09/2026

Eligibility overview

Eligible candidates require a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 score card, Intermediate qualification, the prescribed RCI special-education diploma and valid RCI registration. Download the revised key and notice from the official links below.
